title: Simple Extensions of Single-Objective Acquisition Functions and Hedge Strategies for Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2609.31940v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multi-objective Bayesian optimization (MOBO) is commonly approached through specialized acquisition functions or scalarization schemes designed to explicitly account for trade-offs among non-preferential objectives. In this work, we show that such complexity might be unnecessary. We propose a framework that extends standard single-objective acquisition functions directly to the multi-objective setting through a hypervolume-based methodology. We further extend hedge strategies for acquisition functions, which are typically used only in single-objective optimization, to the multi-objective regime. Our approach requires minimal modification to existing Bayesian optimization pipelines and avoids the need for bespoke multi-objective formulations. translated_title: 面向多目标贝叶斯优化的单目标采集函数与对冲策略的简单扩展
translated_abstract: 多目标贝叶斯优化（MOBO）通常通过专门设计的采集函数或标量化方案来实现，这些方法旨在显式地权衡非偏好性目标之间的取舍。在本工作中，我们表明这种复杂性可能是不必要的。我们提出了一个框架，通过基于超体积的方法，将标准的单目标采集函数直接扩展到多目标设置中。我们进一步将采集函数的对冲策略——通常仅在单目标优化中使用——扩展到多目标场景。我们的方法只需对现有贝叶斯优化流程进行极少的修改，并避免了定制化多目标公式的需求。我们展示了大量常用的单目标采集函数和对冲策略如何能够以有原则的方式被改造以处理多个目标，同时保持……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一个基于超体积的简单框架，能够将常用的单目标采集函数与对冲策略直接扩展到多目标贝叶斯优化中，仅需对现有流程做极小修改，无需专门的多目标设计。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a simple hypervolume-based framework that directly extends standard single-objective acquisition functions and hedge strategies to multi-objective Bayesian optimization, requiring minimal modification to existing pipelines and avoiding bespoke multi-objective formulations.
